models_evaluated: 11 proprietary and open-weight LLMs (Gemini models led)

links.outcome: Physician-rated harm severity of hallucinations, omissions, inaccuracies in LLM clinical summaries
links.effect: Gemini flash had lower severity scores than GPT open-weight across all error categories; hallucinations rare in best model (mean score 0.04) but not absent.
links.quote: Hallucinations were rare in the best-performing model (mean score 0.04), although not entirely absent.

unlisted_practices: LLM-as-a-judge benchmarked against physician consensus for evaluating summaries (Gwet's AC2 0.967 hallucinations, 0.852 inaccuracies)

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs on Spanish clinical summarization and risk factor extraction with physician evaluation, explicitly benchmarking an LLM-as-a-judge oversight approach against physician consensus and testing inference stability criteria.

primary.practice: LLM-as-a-judge automated harm monitoring and multi-run inference stability checks
